verdict.rationale: No documentation shows a real-time GPU availability-by-type/region view or API that lets engineers check capacity before provisioning; only generic marketing about 'thousands of GPUs across 30+ regions' is present, not a live availability check. Community evidence actually describes the failure mode the story wants to avoid — users hitting sudden 'low availability' errors and failed boots for GPU types that were previously available (runpod-comm-4).
